rows.grounds: compound gūḍha plus sadbhāva in accusative singular masculine
present middle third singular of pra-jan

items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature is known?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
items.inference: All-knowingness is the result of knowing the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
